name: Mugi (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Mugi town emblem in red: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a triangle with a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Mugi in Gifu Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-02-07.

features.role: Mugi town emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a triangle with a stylised character
